reviews.author: londell porcher
reviews.text: Took my vehicle in for over heating. Explained to the owner it might need a thermostat and coolant flush. He asked my why did I think that and I said it had happened before but this time there is some nasty residue in the reservoir so do a diagnostic just for a piece of mind.. ok $320.. I got a call my oil cooler is bad it’s mixing with the coolant.. ok $1000.. So that’s $1350 dollars because of course they charge a fee for using a card and I had to split my payment with 2 cards and that was $14 fee each card.. I get a call to pick up my car. I drive my car about an hour.. The same issue is occurring. I take it back and get told it wasn’t enough coolant refilled the coolant and drive off. 1hr later same issue.. This time he does a reflush and tells me he didn’t charge me ( like he did me a favor) even trough the original problem was never fixed.. Now when I call there is no answer. I’ve done business here before however this time I feel taken advantage of I hope we can get some type of resolve.. keep you updated..

reviews.author: Brianna Degler
reviews.text: My mom had her Dodge Avenger worked on here and they were great! Recently, my dad took his 2019 GMC Sierra here for a diagnostic and we learned that there was a lot of problems that would cost at least $3,000. We were advised to get a second opinion and take it in the dealership before the warranty ends. I greatly appreciate the great service we’ve received at Mr. Rodger’s!!

reviews.author: Praxedes Solorio
reviews.text: Amazing Service.. I was in a panic because I thought I had a nail in my tire but my mind my was put at ease he told me it didn’t hold go threw and took out the nail in less than 5 mins... Super grateful and happy with the service I will come back and recommend anyone who needs a tire fixed or repaired

reviews.author: k Turner
reviews.text: Absolutely stay away from this place! It’s extremely disappointing and unethical to deal with this business. What was initially quoted as a simple fix turned into a much larger bill with little explanation or transparency. The work itself did not resolve the issue and within days the car was experiencing the same problem when it was brought back to the shop on two occasions, they were dismissive and unwilling to take responsibility offering no meaningful solution unless a third bill was paid. Throughout the entire process Mr. Rogers made very little effort to understand they may have misdiagnosed the original problem. The bottom line is what was once a very reputable company is now probably one of the worst places to take Car in to be fixed. Extremely disappointing!!!

reviews.author: Grant barton
reviews.text: These guys are awesome! I've been coming here for years, and they always help me out. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: shevie dustin
reviews.text: DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY!!!!Had my son truck towed there March 27, 2026. Due to a bolt that keeps the truck in line and the steering wheel. When you turn the steering wheel the whole front of the truck lifted up and you could clearly see something wasn’t right. I ask if they could fix the problem before taking it there. The guy answering the phone assured me they could fix it. So on March 30 I called that morning for them to tell me they seen nothing wrong with the truck. When clearly there was. He told me he had 3 different mechanics look at it and seen nothing. Got anger with me and my son on the phone and could barely speak English. I had the truck towed to Christian brother where it was fixed by the end of the day. Mr. Rogers tire was very unprofessional and rude, and I will never recommend anyone to go there.

reviews.author: Miles Martin
reviews.text: I've came in several times now for tires, and now brakes, and every time I have came in it has been a great experience. The workers are friendly and so is the owner, and the prices are great for the quality of work that they do.

reviews.author: Andrew Pendermon
reviews.text: I took my car to three different and every other one said the motor needed replaced. Every other shop was trying to charge me to replace the motor. And that was gonna be a lot of money. I came to Mr. Roger to see if he could do it any cheaper and he looked at the car and. Determined it was my alternator, making all the noise. Great honest guy would definitely recommend will 100% be coming back.

reviews.author: Luna Gallego
reviews.text: BEST TIRE SHOP IN THE AREA !! Everyone is very nice and accommodating. They help me out every time. Always quick and explain exactly what they’re doing and why. 10/10 !!

reviews.author: Tammy Collins
reviews.text: Do not go here!! This was my go to guy for a long time. They have done awful work lately. I referred my mom for her check engine light on and after 17 days and not hearing from them she stopped by and they forgot about her truck parked in their back lot and hadnt even looked at it. I had breaks and tires put on back in April in my trash hall truck (dont drive it daily) last week I went to the dump and IT WOULDNT STOP! My uncle took the wheel off to see what happened and my caliper was completely mangled. It wasn't properly installed. A friend from work (that I recommended Mr Rogers too) let me know she ended up getting into a argument with Mr Roger himself because when she went to leave with her car after her repair and didn't even make it out the parking lot before it started making an awful noise. She looked under her hood with him and discovered 6 bolts were missing, and he told her they didn't know where they were and he would have to order them. I have now started going to Heatherly Brothers on hwy 25. So far im happy with this change.

reviews.author: Coker Price
reviews.text: Great mechanics that do great work, for a great price. I moved close to their shop a few years ago and have used them since.

reviews.author: John Nussbaum
reviews.text: These guys were great! I had no idea my rim and wheelbearing assembly got to tore up because the rim was uneven on the wheelbearing and have helped me financially not charging me an arm and leg!

reviews.author: Sean Rose
reviews.text: I've used Mr Roger's a few times with both of my vehicles, they have been friendly and attentive every time, the prices are fair and reasonable. I would recommend this shop

reviews.author: Sal Busacca
reviews.text: I've been using Roger and his crew for 5 years and have never been let down. They do excellent work for fair prices. Repairs or tires, you can't go wrong with Mr Rogers Tires and Towing

reviews.author: Steve Patel
reviews.text: Great Friendly/Honest service. We have 3 cars and have been using Mr. Rogers for the past year and we are completely satisfied. Keep up the good work Mr. Roger. God Bless!

reviews.author: Gabriela B
reviews.text: Great shop. Mr. Roger is so personable and helpful! He made replacing my tires seamless. I came in as a walk in close to closing and they still served me while making sure I was comfortable. Will definitely be back for future services and will recommend to friends!

reviews.author: Jonathan Thomas
reviews.text: I took my vehicle here after blowing a tire. These guys got me back on the road at a great price and were all polite and professional.

reviews.author: Layla S
reviews.text: I had work done to my car by them. They are quite pricey so I had them do some of the job then and come back the following week to finish it. I went back to drop the car off and they could me the mechanic that does that job wasn't there. They took my name and # to give me a call when to drop the car off when he come in. A day or 2 went by I called them to see if he was available I was told he wasn't there that day. I never got that phone call. Second time my mom went up there giving them the benefit of the doubt to fix her car. Something simple that could of been fix they ended up damaging a different part, rigged it up til they are able to get the part in and had the nerve to say if it doesn't work bring it back. It didn't hold long and definitely not going back to Mr. Rogers Tire.

reviews.author: Joshua Reed
reviews.text: Returning to my mechanic for a quick fix-up on my vehicle was a breeze. The familiarity of the garage and the friendly faces of the staff immediately put me at ease. They quickly assessed the issue with my car and efficiently addressed it, demonstrating their expertise and professionalism. Within no time, my vehicle was back in top shape, running smoothly and safely once again. The convenience and reliability of my mechanic's service reaffirmed why I continue to trust them with my automotive needs.

reviews.author: Aaron Watson
reviews.text: Mr. Roger's is great! Great price and very friendly service. I initially went here because it was one of the few places I could pull in my 43ft long 5th wheel trailer to get tires changed, but I will definitely be back because the service was top-notch! If you have a large trailer, this place has the space!

reviews.author: Tara Constantino
reviews.text: Honest and quick service. They were able to get new tires for me in one day. Prices are reasonable. The staff is very helpful and friendly. Will not go elsewhere! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Tanisha Warnick
reviews.text: Had a problem with my car overheating. Took my car to this place and they never fixed the problem. It was a hose they were supposed to replace and they didn’t. Paid almost $600 to get my car fixed and seems like my car is even worse after taking it here. It’s still overheating so I don’t know what they called themselves fixing. They just wanna take your money and not fix anything. So my advice to anyone is don’t take your car here. It’s a rip off!!!!! And then they don’t answer the phone. Tried to call them to let them know my car still isn’t fixed and nobody answered the phone.

reviews.author: antonio hunt
reviews.text: My mother took her car over to this garage decided to give them a chance since close by first of all she paid too much for a 2000 Cavalier $709 for a radiator job radiator brand new was $185 and when she got the car back screws was left off the hood area so it wouldn’t close right! When she took it to them again to repair she reported he said that it wasn’t done by them and she told them as I know to be true that it was closing fine before. He replied that’s what they all say my mom is older and doesn’t deserves to be talked to that way took everything I had not to pay them a visit! But I figured between this review and the Better Business Bureau as well as making it mission to spread the word on them I will do! This business will not prosper doing people like this charging prices they do! God will handle this business better than I could! So I’m Putting them and there business practices in Gods hands and watch him handle it!

reviews.author: Jeannie D
reviews.text: I made a reservation to pick up a UHaul trailer from Mr. Rogers, and while I understand that them not having the correct trailer was an error on UHaul’s end and not their end, the customer service I received was abysmal. I arrived early for my reservation time, and they got to me a few minutes late asking if I could wait because they were busy. I explained that no I couldn’t wait, that I was on time constraints due to moving that day, and needed the trailer at my scheduled time. The man got an attitude with me and told me I “had to understand”. This was after I heard this same mechanic telling a customer outside that it was “too early in the morning for her to come here pissing him off.” He eventually went to look for the trailer but said they didn’t have the correct one that matched my reservation number. Again, not their fault. However, getting an attitude with me when I explained I couldn’t wait past my scheduled pick up time is unacceptable. My family has had amazing experiences with Mr. Rogers in the past, but I can’t say I’ll be returning.

reviews.author: Sean Crittenden
reviews.text: Excellent pricing and are usually able to get me right in. I’ve been going here for a while for oil changes and tire rotations. They also do mechanic work as well but I drive a Ford so I don’t need any of that stuff.

reviews.author: mitch mcantyre
reviews.text: Mr. Rogers provides top notch service and he is someone that I can trust because he is honest and also very affordable. I had a tune up and oil change today, and his team did an outstanding job. I will bring my car to him anytime I need my car serviced.

reviews.author: Matthew Vigari
reviews.text: Great family owned and operated shop. Mr. Roger was extremely kind and helpful. I brought over my own new tires without an appointment and he mounted and balanced them right away. He even went above and beyond to make sure my big tires cleared on my truck and didn’t charge me extra. I will definitely be going back next time I need something done.

reviews.author: Lisa Petrie
reviews.text: I always go to Mr. Roger's Tires & Towing. I made the mistake of going elsewhere one time and almost paid the price of a ruined engine. Of course, Mr. Rogers saved the day AND at a great price! The entire staff is so incredibly nice. I can always trust and count on their service. I've experienced same day service every time we've needed them. I highly recommend this shop!

reviews.author: stephen king
reviews.text: I had a minor coolant leak in my wifes car and took it to see what it was. They found where it appeared to be coming from and showed me and we both agreed what it was. It was a simple overflow cap that had failed but later on I found out it was the heater hose but no fault to them because I didn't want to pay for a fool proof pressure test. Needless to say once I ordered the part and couldn't get it installed I took it back and they had it done in no time and for a unbelievable price. For the total I paid on both trips with a fixed vehicle when I left it would have cost me more at the dealership just for them to tell me what the problem was. Great people, friendly and professional. Amazing job guys

reviews.author: Chelsey da silva
reviews.text: This place is amazing! Very fast service! Everyone was so nice and they don’t take advantage of you, I was a walk-in and they took care of me on the spot with no issues! Thank you Mr. Rogers!

reviews.author: Megan
reviews.text: Absolutely awesome place. I’ve been going to NTB by my house because I can walk home if there’s anything that will take a while. 3 times I’ve gone recently they basically shrugged and said “I dunno why it’s doing what you said. But we found (other problem) that needs to get fixed.” But the other night my car lost all power and I had to leave it at a church. Called Mr.Rogers Tire first thing in the morning and he picked the car up and had it done in just a couple hours, running good as new. Needed an alternator and a new serpentine belt, they called me and just gave me the facts and how much it would be, and was probably half the price it would have been had I taken it to a chain place, and way faster. I drive for a living and had to work later that day and he took care of me. I was at work on time thanks to them. Honest people who try their best to take care of you. Couldn’t be happier.

reviews.author: Chris Petrie
reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about this place. They are honest, reliable, and trustworthy. My wife and I have used their services a few times now, and it's always a great experience. They don't try to "find" things wrong with the vehicle, nor do they try to overcharge you for service. We will definitely be returning customers!

reviews.author: Nancy
reviews.text: What a nice surprise to find such a helpful, courteous and accommodating business. I had a flat tire on a rim that I needed help with. They filled it, checked it out thoroughly while I waited and couldn't find an issue. It's 90 degrees, they took the time to find out what I needed and tried to help! Refreshing human experience. I'll go back for sure. Support local business.

reviews.author: Scott firetto
reviews.text: Mr. Rogers Tire is a honest business you can trust to take your car for repairs or to get tires. I highly recommend him. He and his staff will go above and beyond to make sure his customers are satisfied and happy when they leave.

reviews.author: Sonya Dixon
reviews.text: Service here is TERRIBLE!!!! HE does terrible work!!! How hard is it to put a fuel pump on? I guess to a real mechanic it would not be but Mr Rogers yes!! I dont even think he is a certified mechanic. The new person I had my car towed to was great and my car runs great now. I will never go back to this shop. He gets no star from me.

reviews.author: LeeAnn Sullivan
reviews.text: AMAZING Service!! I am from out of town and I had two flat tires. Rogers offered to grab two wheels from a local junkyard along with changing my tires, they went above and beyond. Highly recommend, the service was incredible.

reviews.author: Joshua Simpson
reviews.text: I went in 8/20/2019 to have an alignment done and have my front end looked over, as I was having issues with my brakes. They diagnosed it as a lower control arms needing to be replaced. I paid for that, an alignment, and four new tires. 9/20/2019 I’m back in the shop, with a destroyed ball joint and calipers, needing a new alignment, but I don’t think much of it, as I’d recently driven out of state to return to school, and assumed it was wear and tear catching up. The mechanic, however, was concerned the damage wasn’t new, and was surprised I’d been given an okay to drive. This past week, Feb 2021, I was back in the shop for an unrelated issue, and after having a diagnostic done, was notified both lower control arms needed replacing, as they hadn’t been replaced in years. They didn’t believe it had been done a little over a year ago, when I showed them my invoice from Mr. Roger’s Tires. I understand natural wear and tear, and this wasn’t it. The work was either half done or not done at all. Once I put two and two together, I realized why my entire brake system and front alignment was jacked the year before. I wouldn’t trust this place to do an alignment or any repairs. I’m paying again to have done what should’ve been done to begin with. What should’ve taken $500 is now costing four times as much to correct.

reviews.author: Ivory Marcell
reviews.text: This is one place I highly recommend. Mr. Roger's Tires & Towing was the only place in the city that took the time to assist us with an emergency flat tire. The knowledge and professional is superior. Thanks to you all my family and I were able to make it back home to Georgia safely!

reviews.author: Marcus D
reviews.text: Hands down the best tire place around. Roger's service is good and his prices fair. I take all of my vehicles there and will continue to in the future.

reviews.author: Towanda Carroll
reviews.text: Very shady ppl I went in for tires and left with my dashboard full of warning lights and he acts like he don’t know what happened . I was so pissed now today my car won’t start no problems with my car until I left that awful shop

reviews.author: Ryan Norton
reviews.text: Very honest people. Every time I come here they are always very professional and very respectful. Hands down the best place to get your vehicle worked on. Thank you for your hard work.

reviews.author: Devon Rice
reviews.text: I called to check if the had a tire for my Camaro. I was informed that there was a tire for me. I told them I’ll be there in 20 minutes it was 4:00. I arrive at the shop and they tell me they can’t help me bc they are closing the shop early after they just told me to come there

reviews.author: Case Crowell
reviews.text: I do not suggest using Mr Roger's as a source for wheel alignment. A wheel alignment consist of setting caster, camber, and toe. After picking up my vehicle and paying for a full alignment, I noticed the technician had only set the toe. He had only done 1/3 of the work. I called and the receptionist told me to bring the vehicle back. I brought the vehicle back and received a call 2.5 hours later that they would not set the caster or camber. Their reasoning was unclear. There was mention of an after market upper control arm, however caster and camber are adjusted on the lower control arm which is an OEM part. If you do not have the ability or equipment to properly align a vehicle it should be disclosed or the service should not be offered. If you do not have the desire then don't waste customers time or money. I'm leaving 2 stars as they gave me 50% of my money back however I'm now out $35 and still have to get an alignment.

reviews.author: Kierstin Bowen
reviews.text: Dropped my car off in the afternoon with an emergency fix.And they got it done by the end of the day and it wasn't even that expensive. Great and speedy service

reviews.author: Erica
reviews.text: They were great, they got my car back to me in just a couple hrs when we thought it would take a day and the repair ended up costing less than half what was estimated. Be aware they moved... 2860b Fork Shoals Rd, Piedmont, SC 29673 This is new address

reviews.author: Benn Silveira
reviews.text: I normally don't post reviews, but I want everyone to read about Mr. Roger's generosity to me and kindness. The first time I went there was just for an inquiry on a potential problem that I may have with my car. He told me kindly the day I was there that if none of his lifts were occupied, that he would lift my car up for me and look at it. He then said just to come by the next morning and he'll lift the car up. I came by a few mornings later and he immediately took me in and lifted my car up. His solution to my proposed problem was to do a tire rotation. I thought I would have to make an appointment, but instead he rotated all four tires right there on the spot for me. Not only did he rotate my tires the day of, but he also did not charge me! For his kind act and helpfulness in figuring out the problem with my car, I would highly recommend taking your vehicle to Mr. Roger's Tires.

reviews.author: Johnny Lindsay
reviews.text: This place was a joke . They gave me a very expensive price on tires and only one technician was available would never recommend anyone to go there didn’t even put my tires on my vehicle and charged me a ridiculous price. What a waste of time!!

reviews.author: Andrew Hemstreet
reviews.text: They were quick to mount my tires but when I asked how much to mount two tires on loose wheels they told me the price of each without say "per" or "each" so it was double what they quoted. Didn't even change the valve stems.

reviews.author: David L H
reviews.text: The mechanics at Mister Rogers we're very polite, straightforward and honest. They don't mark up their parts and they charge reasonable rates for labor, I will be using them for the foreseeable future I suggest y'all do the same.

reviews.author: Bryan Kennedy
reviews.text: Fast, friendly, and didn't break the bank! My tire picked up a piece of metal and couldn't be repaired. They replaced it with a good used tire and got me back on the road in a half hour. I'll be using them again!

reviews.author: David Gray
reviews.text: He has always got my stuff right and went the extra mile to insure rim was clean on inside unlike many others will just slap a tire on and call it good...I travel a long ways just to go to his shop just do to his quality!

reviews.author: michael a
reviews.text: been here a couple times. quality work for a good price. i wouldn't hesitate to recommend Mr Roger's to anybody.

reviews.author: Kelley09
reviews.text: I will never try to do business with this place again. I got my Chrysler 300 towed here after we were referred to go to them from a family friend. We TOLD them what was wrong with my car. I needed a new water pump. They call me after so called inspecting it and said it wasn't the water pump but a hose that needed replacing and they could not repair that at their shop. I ended up getting my car towed AGAIN to another shop and asked them to repair the hose. They gladly repaired the hose and then informed me that the hose wasn't the problem, in fact it was the WATERPUMP that needed replacing. After going back to Mr Roger about the error his shop made through inspection and the extra expense I should not have paid another shop, we didn't receive any empathy at all from him and was even told "It's not my problem." I will never recommend nor attempt to go here again.

reviews.author: scottdarksetscoleman
reviews.text: these guys are always awesome it's definitely my favorite place to go for tires and oil changes. I don't even live in Simpsonville anymore but I will drive the 45 MI just to come here because it also feels like home..

reviews.author: Tameka Williams
reviews.text: Quick service and very friendly. Charged me half of what it would've costed had I taken my vehicle to the dealership for brakes. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Hugh Jasohl
reviews.text: Great local service shop. Got me done in no time and they found tires even cheaper than we originally discussed! I'll be back for sure.

reviews.author: Charisma V
reviews.text: They Always get me in and out! Friendly environment , Bery professional if you speak up and mention your concerns they check it and let you know if your concern is an issue or not. I definitely recommend

reviews.author: King Showoff1
reviews.text: Literally my go to spot for my car got my breaks and rotors done and they did a very good job made my car run like new again almost ! And got my tires from here when they caught nails in them always good service and the workers are very cool and try to get you in and out! Nice establishment

reviews.author: Jeff B. Baker
reviews.text: Mister Rogers tires goes the extra mile. They have a great number of services and are reasonable and professional. I recommend them for New and Used Tires.

reviews.author: Chris Edgar
reviews.text: Great experience and top notch customer service at a great price. Support local business and give this place a shot next time you need service. New location on West Georgia Rd. I'll be going there from now on!

reviews.author: Jodi Johnson
reviews.text: Explained and showed us on a computer the price for cheapest radiator, and all the costs. Car was done in a couple days.

reviews.author: Willie Fisher
reviews.text: Needed two tires put on, told me to come on in fast/friendly and fair prices. Would recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: allison bennett
reviews.text: Mr. Rogers does a fantastic job. It's great to have found someone you can trust. Thank you for your super service

reviews.author: Tim Channel
reviews.text: I was impressed. They were efficient and did a thorough job. Their prices are very competitive as well. I'll be using them again.

reviews.author: Melissa Rose
reviews.text: They want to charge $60 to plug in the machine to check what code the check engine light is throwing I laughed and said I can go get that done at for free at an auto parts store.

reviews.author: D Patterson
reviews.text: Knowledgeable staff always ready to assist with your automotive needs. The owner will do whatever is needed to make sure your experience is a pleasant one!

reviews.author: Carol Conner
reviews.text: Had a nail in my tire they replaced it with my spare! So friendly and fast! Great Guys!!! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Pauline Ponzo
reviews.text: This place is great I got my tires here and they took great care of my car.They have a customer for life!

reviews.author: John McGee
reviews.text: Best place for almost all your Automobile work and tires. The owner Roger and all his employees were great.

reviews.author: jonathan t
reviews.text: He gave me the best quote out of everyone and preformed the work extremely fast. Honest about what was completed and what was needed, I highly recommend

reviews.author: Richard Bardy
reviews.text: I scheduled an appointment for an alignment at 3 p.m. Left my name and number. My wife went to the shop in pouring rain and when she got there they said the alignment guy went home early and to reschedule. You can't call and save my wife the time from fountain inn to your shop. That's why we called for an appointment.

reviews.author: WAYNE TREVINO
reviews.text: Mr Roger is a great guy that does great work at a reasonable price. Don't hesitate to take your vehicle to Mr Roger.

reviews.author: Treasure Peneku
reviews.text: I just moved to sc and needed some work done, this place was great and quick. Reasonable pricing and I will be going back!

reviews.author: Weston Jackson
reviews.text: Local mechanic that does good and honest work. I had some car trouble and Justin was able to fix the issue quickly and at a good price.

reviews.author: Brad Bowman
reviews.text: Finally found a local mechanic is not trying to tell me I need everything "flushed" in my car. Great experience and trustworthy. Will be back!

reviews.author: MATTY RICH
reviews.text: Mr. Rogers is the most honest and professional mechanic out there. Great prices and totally trustworthy!!

reviews.author: David Janowski
reviews.text: Locally owned garage with quick service and mechanics who care that you're car is in the best shape it can be.

reviews.author: Justin Mcbride
reviews.text: Support local business. These guys go above and beyond to make sure the job is done correctly and they have unbeatable prices.

reviews.author: JnT SC (JSC)
reviews.text: I've been coming to this shop for several years to have tires mounted and balanced on all of my vehicles, and I've always had good experiences until my most recent visit. This time, there was a new technician who clearly needed assistance with the job, and the manager had to ask another technician to help him mount my tires. When it was time to pay, I was surprised to see an additional $60 charge on my bill. When I asked about it, I was told that because two technicians worked on my vehicle, I had to pay for the second technician. I don't believe customers should be charged extra simply because an employee needs assistance or additional training. The extra labor was not something I requested, and I was never informed beforehand that there would be an additional charge. As a longtime customer, I found this very disappointing and unfair. Unfortunately, after several years of being a customer, I won't be coming back
